text: In 2021, the property experienced a tree-cover loss of approximately 81.3 hectares, which is about 2.23% of the total asset area. This loss occurred in a planted forest context, primarily affecting planted forests (68.1 hectares) with a small portion outside mapped forest areas (13.2 hectares). The tree-cover loss was mapped by Hansen/UMD and corroborated by later observations and the JRC 2020 reference data. However, it is important to note that this data does not specify the cause of the loss, whether it was legal or illegal, or who was responsible. The loss includes any stand-replacing events, such as cutting a plantation.
